title: Small Business Supports – Digital Marketing or Business Mentorship | Community Futures Manitoba

facts.fact: Indigenous business owners in Manitoba (rural and Winnipeg) can apply for up to $750 in supports from Community Futures Westman's small business supports program.
facts.quote: Indigenous business owners in Manitoba (rural & Winnipeg) can apply for up to $750 in supports.

facts.fact: Funding under the program is capped at $750 per entrepreneur.
facts.quote: Funding is capped at $750 per entrepreneur.

facts.fact: Once an application is approved, funding is paid directly to the service provider or contractor only, not to the entrepreneur.
facts.quote: Once approved, funding is paid directly to the service provider/contractor only.

facts.fact: All service providers and contractors must be registered businesses and must provide their business number.
facts.quote: All service providers/contractors must be registered businesses and must provide their business number.

facts.fact: Applications are reviewed and approved only as funding allows.
facts.quote: Applications will be reviewed and approved as funding allows.

facts.fact: Eligible services are either digital business marketing or support from a business mentor.

Eligible digital marketing supports include graphic designers, web designers, IT supports, e-commerce set-up assistance, social media set-up and content creation, video creation, photography, and digital accessibility.
Eligible business mentorship supports let entrepreneurs learn business skills from an experienced professional and gain business advice.
facts.quote: Learn business skills from an experienced professional

facts.fact: The Community Futures Westman office is at Unit D, 217 10th Street, Brandon, MB, with phone number (204) 726-1513.
